description: In front of you on the bed are a gray plastic tray holding clear ice pieces, a small yellow cup to the left, and a purple handled scoop on the right. The left hand reaches to grasp the yellow cup, lifts it over the tray, tips it downward to dump the ice pieces into the tray, then rotates the cup upright and moves it back toward its original spot while the right hand stays resting near the purple scoop without picking anything up.
